items.excerpt: Defense tech startup Anduril Industries has raised $2.5 billion in a Series G round of funding, more than doubling its valuation to $30.5 billion post-money, the company’s chairman, Trae Stephens, told Bloomberg TV on Thursday.
items.title: Defense Tech Unicorn Anduril Powers Up With $2.5B At $30.5B Valuation

items.excerpt: Energy for AI and automated defense tech led this week’s largest U.S. venture funding deals. Vertical software solutions driven by AI in sports, healthcare and financial services were also a strong theme.
items.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Energy, Defense Tech Led

items.excerpt: Global venture funding ticked up year over year in Q2 2025, reaching $91 billion, with a greater concentration of capital into the largest funding rounds compared to a year ago, Crunchbase data shows.
items.title: Q2 Global Venture Funding Climbs In A Blockbuster Quarter For AI And As Capital Concentrates In Larger Companies

items.excerpt: A total of $12.6 billion was raised by around 1,200 startups across Europe last quarter, with funding amounts comparable with the previous two quarters. And for the first time since 2012, Germany-based startups jumped ahead of the United Kingdom by amounts invested in a quarter.
items.title: Germany Leapfrogs UK To Lead European VC Investment In Q2 As Region’s Funding Settles

items.excerpt: While Europe may lag overall in the race for global AI dominance, the region has produced some strong contenders. The most heavily funded and probably best known is Paris-based generative AI startup Mistral, which today announced a roughly $2 billion Series C round.
items.title: Mistral’s $2B Series C Is Europe’s Largest AI Round By A Lot

items.excerpt: The Crunchbase Unicorn Board crested $6 trillion in total value for the first time in August 2025, adding another half-trillion-plus in value, an unprecedented increase. items.title: In The Space Of Months, AI Funding Boom Adds More Than $500B In Value To Unicorn Board And Reshuffles Top 20

items.excerpt: Black Forest Labs, a German AI image-generating startup, says it has raised $300 million at a $3.25 billion valuation, marking one of the largest investments in a Europe-based AI startup this year.
items.title: Germany’s AI Image Generator Black Forest Labs Raises $300M At $3.25B Valuation As European AI Fundings Scale Up

items.excerpt: Global defense spending is on the rise, and startups are vying for a larger share of the outlays, and it looks like there’s plenty of capital to go around. items.title: Sector Snapshot: Defense Tech Funding Hits Record High

items.excerpt: This year a total of $1.6 trillion of value was added to The Crunchbase Unicorn Board, which lists the most highly valued, private, venture-backed startups in the world. That increase marks the second-largest valuation boost in a year — following only 2021 — an analysis of Crunchbase data shows.
items.title: Hottest Deals In Tech Push Crunchbase Unicorn Board Toward $7T In Value

items.excerpt: Venture funding to Europe-based startups last year gained only slightly, around 9% year over year, reaching $58 billion, with AI emerging as the region’s leading sector for startup investment for the first time, an analysis of Crunchbase data shows.
items.title: European Venture Funding Nudged Higher In 2025, While AI Led For The First Time

items.excerpt: Last year, AI grabbed half of venture dollars globally. But the sector’s blockbuster growth hasn’t necessarily come at the expense of other startup industries. We take a look at five areas benefiting from AI-driven automation that have seen venture funding increase significantly in recent quarters.
items.title: 5 Startup Sectors Seeing Big Funding Growth

items.excerpt: Defense tech startups are on a tear, which became clear this week when shares of AI drone company Swarmer soared 520% in their first day of trading on the Nasdaq, which could pave the way for other startups in the sector to pursue IPOs. We take a look at other likely candidates.
items.title: After Swarmer’s Soaring Debut, Here Are 12 Other Potential Defense Tech IPOs

items.excerpt: Global venture funding showed no signs of slowing in July. Startup capital totaled $55 billion, up 69% year over year, as the month notched the highest-ever number of billion-dollar venture rounds on record, per Crunchbase data.
